newsitem.title: USA: Cheniere cancels offshore Cal. oil buy.
newsitem.headline: Cheniere cancels offshore Cal. oil buy.

text.p: Cheniere Energy Inc said Wednesday that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Cheniere Energy California Inc, has decided not to buy an interest in the Bonito Unit of the Pacific Outer Continental Shelf off Santa Barbara County, California.

Cheniere said it decided not to follow through on the purchase from Poseidon Petroleum LLC because, it said, it wanted to concentrate on its ongoing proprietary 3-D seismic exploration program along the coastal transition zone of southwestern Louisiana.

Cheniere focuses on early-stage oil and gas projects characterized by high reserve potential in which the company can obtain a large working interest. The company's first project is in the Louisiana transition zone.
